d:
Our first trip to Namibia, and what an adventure it has been!
Namibia has been on our bucket list for a long time, and this time we decided to explore this beautiful African country on a self-drive road trip.
If you're planning a trip to Namibia from India, this video is for you! We share everything we learned while planning our journey, including:
Flights to Namibia – How to reach Namibia from India
Namibia Visa – Visa requirements and what you need to know as an Indian passport holder
Car Rental – How to rent a car, what to consider and tips for self-driving in Namibia
